# Digital Guardian Wellness

> Digital Guardian Wellness is a digital wellness platform helping families build healthy screen-time habits, online safety skills, and family commitments. It offers educational games, video resources, a community hub with regional chapters (UAE, Kenya), and an Elite Mentor Circle of certified digital wellness professionals.

## Key pages
- Home: https://digitalguardianwellness.org/
- Educational Blog: https://digitalguardianwellness.org/blog
- Video Resources: https://digitalguardianwellness.org/videos
- Community Hub: https://digitalguardianwellness.org/community
- Family Commitments: https://digitalguardianwellness.org/family-commitments
- Family Digital Agreements: https://digitalguardianwellness.org/family-agreements
- Screen Time Management: https://digitalguardianwellness.org/screen-time
- Interactive Games: https://digitalguardianwellness.org/games
- Workshops: https://digitalguardianwellness.org/workshops
- Course: https://digitalguardianwellness.org/course
- Privacy Policy: https://digitalguardianwellness.org/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://digitalguardianwellness.org/terms

## About
- Chatbot assistant: "Welli" — answers FAQs and navigates users to site features.
- Chrome extension: DigitalGuard browser extension for family screen-time enforcement.
- Regional chapters: UAE (English + Arabic), Kenya (English).
- Mentor circle: certified professionals in digital wellness, SEN/inclusion, family support, mental health, parenting, youth mentorship, elderly care.
